ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a large circle, and inside it there are four semicircular arcs in a rotationally symmetric "pinwheel" shape, dividing the large circle into four congruent regions. Observe any one region: its boundary is composed of one quarter-circle arc on the outer circumference of the large circle, as well as two internal semicircular arcs. Then reason: The radius of the large circle is 4 cm, so the length of one quarter of the circumference of the large circle is (1/4)·2π·4=2π. The radius of each internal semicircle is 2 cm, therefore the length of one semicircular arc is π·2=2π. One region contains two such internal semicircular arcs, totaling 4π. Thus the perimeter of one region is 2π+4π=6π cm.

raw_record.question_text: A circle of radius $4 \mathrm{~cm}$ is divided, as shown, by four semicircles with radius $2 \mathrm{~cm}$ into four congruent parts. What is the perimeter of one of these parts?

method.method_draft: 先看图像：大圆内有4条对称的半圆弧，把圆分成4个全等部分；其中任一部分的边界可以看成“外圈上一段四分之一圆弧 + 两段内侧半圆弧”。再读文字：大圆半径是4 cm，内侧每个半圆半径是2 cm。推理时直接算边界长度：大圆的四分之一周长是 (1/4)·2π·4 = 2π；每个半圆弧长是 π·2 = 2π，两个半圆弧共 4π。相加得 6π。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个大圆，内部有四条半圆弧呈旋转对称的“风车”形状，把大圆分成四个全等区域。观察任意一个区域，它的边界由大圆外周上的一段四分之一圆弧，以及内部两段半圆弧组成。再推理：大圆半径为4 cm，所以大圆四分之一周长为(1/4)·2π·4=2π。每条内部半圆的半径为2 cm，因此一条半圆弧长为π·2=2π。一个区域包含两条这样的内部半圆弧，共4π。于是一个区域的周长为2π+4π=6π cm。
